name: Paused Deadlift
instructions: Set up for a conventional deadlift and pull the bar off the floor.
Pause for 1-2 seconds just below the knee, staying tight.
Finish the pull to full lockout.
Lower with control. The pause eliminates momentum and builds positional strength.
longevityNotes: A strong hinge is back insurance. Learn it light, groove it often, and add load slowly — the goal is a back that never complains about picking things up.
overview: Paused Deadlift is an advanced hip-hinge exercise targeting the glutes, performed with a barbell. The hinge is the foundation of safe lifting — it teaches you to load the hips, not the spine.
